prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: transparent RGBA sprite atlas for a high-quality handcrafted layered-paper pop-up rainforest battle terrarium inspired by Pokémon Emerald's rainy Route 119. Generate a new atlas, not a assembled scene. Landscape 1536x1024 if possible. Twelve COMPLETE separated front-facing cutout objects in a strict 4 column by 3 row grid, equal cells, generous fully transparent gaps and 20px margin inside every cell. No object touches another or the image border. No text, no grid lines, no labels, no shadows on the transparent background.
Style: exquisite flat colored cardstock collage, playful rich emerald/teal/lime foliage, warm tan paper edges, unmistakably thin overlapping individually cut paper leaves with delicate paper fibers and tiny fold veins. Every silhouette has crisp thin cream cut edges. Depth only from overlapping flat paper layers and small contact shadows within each object. NO photoreal foliage, NO 3D model rendering, NO chunky low-poly rocks, NO realistic wet textures, NO painted solid scenery panels. Many detailed individually shaped leaves, varied silhouettes, tasteful subtle orange/white flowers. The camera faces the pieces like theatre scenery, slight view of top surfaces only where useful.
Objects reading left to right:
Row 1: (1) tall broad buttress-root rainforest tree with branching tan flat trunk and 5 overlapping asymmetrical green leafy crown tiers, hanging vines and one tiny orange flower; (2) banana/palm cluster with individually creased long broad bright green leaves and thin trunks; (3) a different spreading rainforest tree with small paired leaves, exposed roots and teal lower crown; (4) stepped moss-covered grey cut-paper rock waterfall, three distinct azure falling ribbons and cream scalloped paper foam, transparent irregular outer silhouette, small plants attached to sides, no rectangular background.
Row 2: (1) isolated gently sagging rope footbridge stretching horizontally with detailed tan paper planks and paper rope railings, transparent openings between ropes, no landscape; (2) hanging canopy fringe of individually cut vines and leaves, irregular hanging tendrils, no horizontal rectangular backing; (3) asymmetric soft grey-blue rain cloud made of four overlapping rounded paper shapes with cream edges; (4) a different smaller rain cloud plus 3 small separately cut blue raindrops underneath, all contained in its cell.
Row 3: (1) detailed spreading fern clump with 7 separate flat cut fronds, visible cream stems; (2) bromeliad clump with pointed folded lime/teal leaves and two warm orange flower spikes; (3) mossy fallen tan paper log with 2 tiny mushrooms and overlapping leaves, entirely flat layered cutout; (4) small foreground broad-leaf plant with 5 separate leaves and 3 tiny white flowers.
This is a cohesive professional game sprite sheet with clean transparency, charming lush layered paper craft and readable silhouettes, not a photo or a mockup of a book. Preserve all 12 complete individual components with generous spacing.
